recommendation: Preserve narrow retrospective development and transfer claims. No new independent same-domain/calibration units were admitted. wwkpzj3vfk.4 remains a previously closed materially different candidate, not an authorized numerical fallback. Truly new author-held native curves or a genuinely new independently mapped public source are needed for stronger confirmation claims.
claims_boundary: A transparent narrow-domain development manuscript need not establish every possible generalization claim. This source gate only limits stronger independent-batch and calibration claims; it does not estimate MLST acceptance probability.
